name: Three-Provider Routing
tagline: Filter offline providers across a 3-provider network.
brief: Select the cheapest active provider among three available options.
context: Three providers (A, B, C) are connected. Provider C is offline.
narrative:
YamusaPay is now connected to three providers: A, B, and C.

Provider C is offline and must be avoided. Between the active providers A and B, Provider B offers the lowest fee.

Filter out offline providers first, then select Provider B to process the transaction stream.
objective: Process every payment without failures and keep total cost at or below ₦0.41.
learningObjective: Filter out unavailable routes and pick the lowest-cost active option.
intelligenceExplanation:
Provider C is offline. Provider B is online and cheaper than Provider A.

Add rule: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b to route all transactions to Provider B.
hint: Route through Provider B: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b.
hints: Provider C is offline — never route to C.
Compare active providers: B is cheaper than A.

steps.label: Keep total cost at or below ₦0.41

functions.description: Send the payment through Provider A.
Send the payment through Provider B.
Send the payment through Provider C.
Hold the payment for a tick.
